Boston Common Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc Com (AAPL) by 1.36% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Boston Common Asset Management Llc sold 2,402 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 174,513 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $29.28M, down from 176,915 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Boston Common Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $908.91 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.29% or $0.54 during the last trading session, reaching $184.92. About 15.09M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 24, 2017 and is uptrending.
